english_outline.section1_main_conclusion: Amazon Q3 2026: revenue $201.9B, operating income $28.1B, AWS +39.3% YoY. EPS $1.89 missed $1.96 consensus. Stock fell 4.25% regular, 6.11% after hours. Reuters: AI spending eclipses cloud growth. AP: cautious Q4 view.
english_outline.section2_core_business_changes: AWS revenue $46B, operating income $17.8B (38.7% margin). Advertising $19.6B +12%. North America $112.9B +6%. International $43.1B +8% ex-FX. Capex $75.9B quarterly. Management: AWS can grow >40% in 2027-2028.
english_outline.section3_impact_on_expectations: Operating margin 13.9% record high. Operating income +61% YoY. But EPS miss and heavy capex raise near-term profit pressure concerns. Q4 sales guidance below estimates per Reuters. Market weighs spending vs growth.
english_outline.section4_market_pricing: Stock fell 4.25% to $243.79 regular, then 6.11% to $228.9 after hours. Total ~10.1% drop from prior close. Investing.com: investors focused on EPS miss and spending. Reuters: AI spending eclipses fastest cloud growth in five years. AP: cautious view after disappointing 3Q.
english_outline.section5_next_quarter_validation: Q4 sales guidance vs actual. AWS growth sustainability above 40%. Capex trajectory and impact on margins. Advertising and retail margin trends. EPS recovery vs consensus.

reader_questions: 原稿称AWS增速为'五年来最快'，但来源中仅Reuters标题提及'fastest cloud growth in five years'，公司官方新闻稿是否支持这一表述？
原稿将'净资产收益率31%'作为运营改善证据，但该指标是否来自公司官方财报，还是仅见于Investing.com的二手整理？
原稿称'管理层在财报电话会上表示，AWS在2027年和2028年可以保持超过40%的增长'，但来源中该表述是否明确归属于管理层，还是仅见于Investing.com的转述？
checks: 核查：官方来源仅确认AWS销售额同比增长39.3%，未出现'五年来最快'的定性表述。Reuters标题含'fastest cloud growth in five years'，属于市场报道的概括，不能作为公司官方事实。修订稿应删除'五年来最快'，仅保留39.3%的官方增速。
核查：净资产收益率31%仅见于Investing.com的整理，官方新闻稿未列出该指标。原稿将其作为运营改善证据，属于引入未见于官方来源的数字。修订稿应删除该指标，改用官方确认的营业利润、营业利润率等数据。
核查：Investing.com转述'Management said AWS can grow north of 40% in 2027 and 2028'，但官方新闻稿未包含该前瞻表述。原稿将其写成'管理层在财报电话会上表示'，来源归属不够精确。修订稿应改为'据Investing.com对财报电话会的转述'，或删除该前瞻性表述。
